sents.t: Rosa wants to grow her own vegetables this summer.
Behind our building, there is a small piece of land, and Mr. Brooks said, “You can use it for a garden.”
On Saturday, Rosa and I went to the garden center.
“How many tomato plants do we need?” I asked.
We also bought seeds for carrots, beans, and lettuce, and a few herbs like basil and mint.
Back home, I dug the ground, and Rosa showed me how to plant the seeds.
“And don’t put them too close together. Plants need space.”
Unfortunately, he dug a big hole right in the middle of the carrots!
“You plant a tiny seed, you water it every day, and you wait. One day, you have a tomato.”
Yesterday, I saw the first green leaves coming out of the soil.

comp.q: Who said they could use the land?
comp.fa: چه کسی گفت می‌توانند از آن زمین استفاده کنند؟

comp.q: How many tomato plants did they buy?
How many bags of soil did they get?

o: dug a hole in the carrots

comp.q: What does gardening teach you, says Rosa?
comp.fa: به گفته‌ی رزا، باغبانی چه چیزی به آدم یاد می‌دهد؟
